<span class="section-tag">Portfolio</span>
<h2 class="section-title">Featured <span>Projects</span></h2>
<div class="divider"></div>
<p class="section-sub">Each project is a story — a question I had, a challenge I tackled, and an insight I uncovered.</p>

<div class="projects-list">

  <!-- PROJECT 1: Bollywood -->
  <div class="project-card">
    <div class="project-card-inner">
      <div class="project-meta">
        <span class="project-category">Data Analysis & Visualization</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="project-title">Bollywood Movie Analysis: Where I Fell in Love with Data Science</h3>
      <p class="project-highlight">This project changed everything for me. As someone who loves Bollywood movies (especially Shah Rukh Khan!), I wanted to explore how data could tell stories about my favorite actors.</p>

      <h4>Key Questions I Explored</h4>
      <ul>
        <li>How does the genre of a movie influence its IMDB rating?</li>
        <li>Are established actors linked to higher movie ratings over the years?</li>
      </ul>

      <h4>What I Discovered</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Shahid Kapoor:</strong> Strong recent performance with higher ratings in 2022–2023</li>
        <li><strong>Salman Khan:</strong> Fluctuating ratings, suggesting mixed audience reception</li>
        <li><strong>Akshay Kumar & Ajay Devgn:</strong> Consistent mid-range performance</li>
        <li><strong>Amitabh Bachchan:</strong> Sustained appeal over time</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="insight-box">
        <strong>Key Insight:</strong> While established actors attract viewers, movie ratings vary significantly based on plot, direction, and audience expectations — not just star power.
      </div>

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="ptag">R</span>
        <span class="ptag">ggplot2</span>
        <span class="ptag">dplyr</span>
        <span class="ptag">tidyverse</span>
        <span class="ptag">Statistical Analysis</span>
      </div>

      <div class="project-footer">
        <a href="https://github.com/TasnimAra-Project/Bollywood_Movie_Analysis" class="btn-project">View on GitHub →</a>
        <span class="impact-badge">⭐ Personal Passion Project</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROJECT 2: Climate Change Shiny App -->
  <div class="project-card">
    <div class="project-card-inner">
      <div class="project-meta">
        <span class="project-category">Interactive Dashboard & Analysis</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="project-title">Climate Change Shiny App: Challenging Assumptions with Data</h3>
      <p class="project-highlight">Growing up in Bangladesh, I always heard about pollution in South Asian countries. I wanted to challenge these assumptions by building an interactive tool to explore global CO₂ emissions data.</p>

      <h4>What I Set Out to Explore</h4>
      <ul>
        <li>Are South Asian countries really the biggest CO₂ contributors?</li>
        <li>How do emissions compare between developing and developed nations?</li>
        <li>What are the economic and agricultural impacts of emissions?</li>
      </ul>

      <h4>Key Discoveries</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Challenged Stereotypes:</strong> South Asian countries aren't the biggest CO₂ contributors</li>
        <li><strong>Global Comparison:</strong> Developed nations often have higher per-capita emissions</li>
        <li><strong>Multi-dimensional Impact:</strong> Economic & agricultural effects across different countries</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="insight-box">
        <strong>Technical Achievement:</strong> Built an interactive Shiny dashboard that allows users to explore emissions data, compare countries, and understand the economic and agricultural consequences of climate change.
      </div>

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="ptag">R Shiny</span>
        <span class="ptag">ggplot2</span>
        <span class="ptag">dplyr</span>
        <span class="ptag">tidyverse</span>
        <span class="ptag">Comparative Analysis</span>
      </div>

      <div class="project-footer">
        <a href="https://github.com/TasnimAra-Project/Climate_Change_Shiny_App" class="btn-project">View on GitHub →</a>
        <span class="impact-badge">🌍 Challenged Assumptions</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROJECT 3: Sentiment Analysis -->
  <div class="project-card">
    <div class="project-card-inner">
      <div class="project-meta">
        <span class="project-category">Natural Language Processing & Business Intelligence</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="project-title">Employee Sentiment Analysis: My Journey with Hugging Face & NLP</h3>
      <p class="project-highlight">My first deep dive into Hugging Face and advanced NLP. This project challenged me to work with unlabeled data and find the right sentiment analysis solution for employee communications.</p>

      <h4>The Challenge</h4>
      <ul>
        <li>Unlabeled dataset of employee emails and communications</li>
        <li>First time working with Hugging Face and advanced NLP models</li>
        <li>Need to classify sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral</li>
      </ul>

      <h4>My Technical Journey</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Initial Approach:</strong> Tested BERT, TextBlob, and Vader</li>
        <li><strong>Research & Testing:</strong> Explored multiple Hugging Face libraries</li>
        <li><strong>Final Solution:</strong> Implemented cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment</li>
        <li><strong>Validation:</strong> Manually checked results for quality and accuracy</li>
      </ul>

      <h4>Business Impact Delivered</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Employee Engagement Insights:</strong> Identified communication patterns and trends</li>
        <li><strong>Flight Risk Model:</strong> Predicted employees at risk of leaving</li>
        <li><strong>Predictive Analytics:</strong> Forecasted sentiment scores for future planning</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="ptag">Hugging Face</span>
        <span class="ptag">Python</span>
        <span class="ptag">Transformers</span>
        <span class="ptag">Pandas</span>
        <span class="ptag">Scikit-learn</span>
        <span class="ptag">Matplotlib</span>
      </div>

      <div class="project-footer">
        <a href="https://github.com/TasnimAra-Project/sentiment_analysis_employee" class="btn-project">View on GitHub →</a>
        <span class="impact-badge">💬 NLP & Business Intelligence</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROJECT 4: Deal Activity Prediction -->
  <div class="project-card">
    <div class="project-card-inner">
      <div class="project-meta">
        <span class="project-category">Machine Learning & Business Intelligence</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="project-title">Deal Activity Prediction: From Unsupervised to GPT-Enhanced ML</h3>
      <p class="project-highlight">My biggest challenge yet: predicting deal closure probability from an unlabeled dataset of wealth management activities. This project pushed me to innovate with GPT-4 labeling and advanced ML techniques.</p>

      <h4>Phase 1: Unsupervised Learning</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>KMeans Clustering:</strong> Extracted numeric features (total activities, engagement days) — 29.8% agreement</li>
        <li><strong>Agglomerative Clustering:</strong> Hierarchical clustering with k=3 — 34.2% agreement</li>
      </ul>

      <h4>Phase 2: GPT-4 Enhanced Supervised Learning</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Data Processing:</strong> Flattened nested JSON, created chronological summaries</li>
        <li><strong>GPT-4 Labeling:</strong> Generated High/Medium/Low labels with reasoning</li>
        <li><strong>Model Training:</strong> Random Forest vs XGBoost with SMOTE balancing</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="insight-box">
        <strong>Key Breakthrough:</strong> GPT-4 labeling captured business context that pure statistical methods missed — a 97% improvement in accuracy (34% → 67% with XGBoost).
      </div>

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="ptag">Python</span>
        <span class="ptag">OpenAI GPT-4</span>
        <span class="ptag">XGBoost</span>
        <span class="ptag">Random Forest</span>
        <span class="ptag">Clustering</span>
        <span class="ptag">Feature Engineering</span>
      </div>

      <div class="project-footer">
        <a href="https://github.com/TasnimAra-Project/Deal-Activity-Prediction" class="btn-project">View on GitHub →</a>
        <span class="impact-badge">📈 97% Accuracy Improvement</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROJECT 5: Legal Chatbot -->
  <div class="project-card">
    <div class="project-card-inner">
      <div class="project-meta">
        <span class="project-category">AI Chatbot & Database Design</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="project-title">Social Justice Legal Resource Chatbot: Technology for Community Empowerment</h3>
      <p class="project-highlight">My most meaningful project yet: building a chatbot that acts as a virtual social justice lawyer, connecting vulnerable communities with critical legal resources based on their location and specific needs.</p>

      <h4>Technical Architecture</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>SQL Database:</strong> Comprehensive legal resource repository with location-based indexing</li>
        <li><strong>Resource Categories:</strong> Housing, employment, immigration, family law, civil rights</li>
        <li><strong>Geographic Integration:</strong> ZIP code-based resource matching and filtering</li>
        <li><strong>ChatGPT Integration:</strong> Natural language understanding and context-aware responses</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="insight-box">
        <strong>Example Impact:</strong> "I'm getting kicked out of my home" + ZIP code → immediate housing legal aid resources with contact information, service areas, and eligibility criteria.
      </div>

      <div class="project-tags">
        <span class="ptag">ChatGPT API</span>
        <span class="ptag">SQL</span>
        <span class="ptag">Python</span>
        <span class="ptag">Database Design</span>
        <span class="ptag">NLP</span>
      </div>

      <div class="project-footer">
        <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-style: italic;">🚧 GitHub repository coming soon</span>
        <span class="impact-badge">⚖️ Social Impact Project</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
